events.text: Romulus Augustulus is deposed, marking the end of the Western Roman Empire.
Spanish settlers found the city of Los Angeles.
The French Third Republic is proclaimed in Paris.
Thomas Edison's Pearl Street Station starts supplying electricity to New York City.
Apache leader Geronimo surrenders to U.S. forces in Arizona.
George Eastman registers the trademark Kodak and patents his roll-film camera.
The first live coast-to-coast television broadcast in the U.S. shows President Truman's speech in San Francisco.
The Little Rock Nine are blocked from entering Central High School in Arkansas.
Mark Spitz wins his seventh gold medal at the Munich Olympics.
Google is founded by Larry Page and Sergey Brin.
